summary: 4x4 matrix multiply with output-alias handling (stdcall, three char pointers: a1 output, a2 first operand, a3 second operand). If either input aliases the output, the product is computed into a stack temp buffer; otherwise it is written directly. On completion, if the temp buffer was used, 64 bytes (0x40) are copied back into a1. Returns a1.

operations.description: Guard on (a1 == a2 || a1 == a3): if either input aliases the output, compute into a stack temp buffer instead of writing in place.
v3 = &v11 (stack temp buffer); v12 = v3 records which destination was actually used.
Outer row loop (v6 from -4 to 0, 4 iterations); the first operand row pointer ECX advances by 16 bytes per row.
Inner loop (ESI from -4 to 0, 4 iterations) computing one output element per iteration.
x87 dot-product accumulation: four fld/fmul products of the a2 row (ecx) with a3 column elements (edx+esi*4+10h..40h) are summed and stored as a float at v8 (= v3[4*v6+16]).
Guard on v12 != a1: the result was written to the temp buffer and must be copied back.
qmemcpy copies 0x40 (64) bytes from the temp buffer (v12) into the output a1.
